description: This file defines an interface 'ShutdownReason' which models the reason for issuing a shutdown command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods to retrieve the type of shutdown reason and to check relevance for given details. It also contains a nested class defining JSON field constants related to 'ShutdownReason'.

classes.name: ShutdownReason
classes.description: An interface representing the reason for a shutdown command, providing methods to access the type and relevance checks based on details.

classes.name: ShutdownReason.JsonFields
classes.description: A holder class for JSON field definitions related to ShutdownReason, such as 'type' and 'details'.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Retrieves the type of the shutdown reason.

methods.name: isRelevantFor
methods.description: Determines whether this shutdown reason is relevant for the provided value.

methods.name: isRelevantFor (Object)
methods.description: Checks if the shutdown reason is relevant based on an object value.
